Read and modify species parameterization files

Source: R/make_inputs.R
read_species.Rd

read_species reads a species parameterization file (e.g. Piceaabies.txt) as a data.frame. set_species_param changes the value of one or more parameters, keeping comments and the order of the file, and optionally writes the result in a new file (e.g. to create a new parameterization or for sensitivity analysis).

Usage

read_species(file)

set_species_param(file, ..., outfile = file)

Arguments

file

Character: path to the species file

...

Named values of the parameters to be changed, e.g. LIGHT_TOL = 3, SLA_AVG0 = 8

outfile

Character: path of the file to be written. Default to file (the file is overwritten)

Value

read_species: a data.frame with columns parameter and value. set_species_param: invisibly, the previous values of the changed parameters.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
sp <- read_species("Piceaabies.txt")
set_species_param("Piceaabies.txt", LIGHT_TOL = 3, outfile = "Piceaabies_lt3.txt")
} # }
